text: 你们的声音和气味让潜近猎物的计划无法奏效，但你们在黏土中发现足迹，像是大型猫科掠食者留下的。你把诺曼和西尔维娅留在岩丘脚下，带伯纳德去狩猎。你看得出他正压抑着孩子般的兴奋。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 610
text: The sounds and smells of your group defeat any attempt to stalk game, but you find prints in the clay that suggest a large feline predator. You leave Norman and Sylvia at the foot of a rocky hill and take Bernard on the hunt. You can tell he is suppressing a boyish excitement.
